plugins.name: maven-mcp
plugins.description: Maven dependency intelligence — dependency updates, vulnerability and license scanning, transitive dependency graphs, version compatibility checks, artifact search, and version-catalog management, exposed as Claude Code skills. Works in Claude cloud and local without any NPM setup.

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: Fetches existing YouTube subtitles (manual or auto-generated) via the InnerTube API and returns them as plain text, SRT, or VTT. Does not perform speech-to-text or video/audio download — only retrieves captions YouTube already publishes.
